key_insight: EchoChat is a multimodal generative AI model that supports comprehensive echocardiographic interpretation across 33 cardiac conditions and findings.
clinical_relevance: AI-assisted reports achieved higher diagnostic F1 than routine-reader-only reports in a reader study, suggesting potential to support clinicians facing interpretation workloads.
method: Trained on echocardiography–instruction pairs from 46,358 examinations.
Combines echocardiographic visual inputs with medical knowledge and explicit reasoning intended to ground conclusions in visual evidence.
Evaluated condition recognition, quantitative measurements, and clinician–AI co-generated reports.
evidence_signal: Across cohorts from six international centers, EchoChat achieved 73.7% average F1 for 15 newly added conditions in available external evaluations; reader-study diagnostic F1 increased from 72.78% to 82.75% with AI assistance.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish prospective real-world safety or patient-outcome benefits; generated reasoning and findings require clinician verification.
paper_title: Multimodal Generative AI Assists Comprehensive Echocardiographic Interpretation
